info.title: Finance Copilot API
info.description: Track, plan, learn and practise across every country you live and bank in. Information and simulations only, never financial advice.

get.description: Every country. All have basic support; has_pack marks full support.

schema.title: Response List Countries V1 Countries Get

delete.description: Permanently delete your account and everything linked to it.

get.description: A new user's first steps, each ticked off from their own data.

put.description: Add a country to your profile, or change your relationship to it. Any country works.

get.description: Everything stored about you, as a zip of CSV files.

schema.title: Response List Accounts V1 Accounts Get

delete.description: Deletes the account and all its transactions. Archive it instead to keep history.

schema.title: Response List Categories V1 Categories Get
Response List Rules V1 Category Rules Get

post.description: Categorise every uncategorised transaction using your rules and the country defaults.
Parse the file and show what would be imported. Nothing is saved.

schema.title: Response List Imports V1 Imports Get

post.description: Import the file into the account. Safe to repeat: rows already imported are skipped.

schema.title: Response List Saved Mappings V1 Csv Mappings Get
Response List Budgets V1 Budgets Get

put.description: Create or change the monthly budget for one category in one country.

get.description: Spent vs remaining for each budget in a country, for one month (default: this month).

schema.title: Response Budget Status V1 Budgets Status Get

get.description:
Everything you hold across all your countries, in one currency (default: your home currency).
Accounts whose currency has no exchange rate yet are listed but left out of the total.
Spending by category for one month, and income vs spending for the months before it.

schema.title: Response List Remittances V1 Remittances Get

get.description: Totals across all transfers, in one currency (default: your home currency).

schema.title: Response List Goals V1 Goals Get

post.description:
Uses your own data for anything you leave empty: average spending over the last
3 full months, and the balance of your savings and cash accounts in that country.

schema.title: Response List Packs V1 Admin Country Packs Get

post.description: Create a new draft version of a country's pack. It does nothing until activated.
Make this version live for its country. The previous active version is retired, not deleted.
Trigger the exchange-rate job by hand. Normally it runs on a schedule.

CsvMapping.title: CsvMapping
CsvMapping.description:
How to read one bank's CSV export. Columns are header names when the file
has a header row, or 0-based positions when it does not.

monthly_expenses.title: Monthly Expenses
monthly_expenses.description: Leave empty to use your average spending over the last 3 full months

current_savings.title: Current Savings
current_savings.description: Leave empty to use the balance of your savings and cash accounts

amount_sent.title: Amount Sent
amount_sent.description: Everything you paid, including the fee
